rationale: The plan correctly frames PROGENy mlm as a footprint (human weights, top 500 responsive genes, BH across 14 pathways, coverage reported, membership ORA explicitly rejected) and handles sample_01 well: kept, inspected on PCA and distance heatmap, library size reported, leave-one-out sensitivity, removal only with a stated reason. Its main departure from the reference is that it never fits the count model: no DESeq2 Wald or edgeR QL contrast, so the primary decoupleR input is a per-sample log-CPM matrix with limma on scores rather than the per-gene Wald statistic, and normalization is a bare edgeR cpm call with no TMM factors stated and no size-factor model. The reference level, the alpha for BH, and any gene-level tested/significant counts are not stated, and fold-change shrinkage is moot only because no gene-level test exists. The report specification is otherwise thorough, naming the network versions, estimator, input, contrast, limitations and reproducibility record.
